title: Agentao: A Governed Local-First Runtime for Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.13574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate as execution systems that invoke tools, modify local state, use persistent memory, and interact with external protocols. These capabilities make agents useful, but they also introduce risks related to over-privileged actions, weak auditability, prompt injection, tool poisoning, and uncontrolled side effects. This paper presents Agentao, a governed local-first runtime for tool-using LLM agents. Agentao separates model-generated action proposals from host-authorized execution through a layered architecture consisting of host-facing surfaces, a host contract, a runtime core, a permission-mediated tool system, and supporting subsystems for memory, replay, plugins, skills, sub-agents, and protocol integration. We describe the motivation, threat model, design goals, governance model, execution pipeline, and structured event interface of the system. translated_title: Agentao：一种受治理的本地优先运行时，用于使用工具的LLM代理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13574v1 公告类型：新  摘要：LLM代理越来越多地作为执行系统运行，调用工具、修改本地状态、使用持久内存，并与外部协议交互。这些能力使代理变得有用，但也引入了与过度权限操作、弱审计性、提示注入、工具投毒和不受控制的副作用相关的风险。本文介绍了Agentao，一种用于使用工具的LLM代理的受治理的本地优先运行时。Agentao通过分层架构将模型生成的动作提案与宿主授权的执行分离，该架构包括宿主面对接口、宿主契约、运行时核心、权限中介工具系统，以及用于内存、重放、插件、技能、子代理和协议集成的支持子系统。我们描述了系统的动机、威胁模型、设计目标、治理模型、执行管道和结构化事件接口。Agentao不提供形式化的安全保证；相反，它降低了风险，并增强了审计性和可控性。
tldr: Agentao通过分层架构分离模型提案与宿主授权执行，增强了工具使用LLM代理的治理、审计性和可控性，降低了安全风险。
en_tdlr: Agentao enhances governance, auditability, and controllability of tool-using LLM agents by separating model proposals from host-authorized execution via a layered architecture, mitigating security risks.
